cases.prompt: Fix a typo in one localized UI label and verify the changed file.
assertions: Makes only the requested localized change

cases.prompt: On Plus, add a well-specified API field and update its independent UI consumer.
assertions: Uses no more than two independent workers

cases.prompt: On Pro, verify the current official API behavior, implement the change, and add focused tests.
assertions: Uses non-overlapping research and implementation work packages
Keeps architectural decisions at the root

cases.prompt: Investigate three hypotheses in a large repository where all depend on the same configuration file.
assertions: Avoids sending the same large context to three workers

cases.prompt: Refactor an internal helper with complete focused test coverage.
assertions: Does not create an independent Astra reviewer

cases.prompt: Change an authentication migration that can invalidate existing sessions.
assertions: Uses a bounded high-capability implementation route

cases.prompt: Build and visually verify a responsive landing page using the Astra frontend design skill.
assertions: Keeps product intent and visual acceptance at the root
Delegates bounded implementation only when useful
Performs one responsive visual QA loop
